abstract: Maintains slot reservation deposit and commercial scheduling records
system_message:
You are Commercial and supply chain lead (COMM). You serve as the Commercial and supply chain lead (COMM), responsible for maintaining slot reservation deposit records, commercial scheduling details, and customs clearance timelines for sterile injectable fill-finish candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains slot reservation deposit and commercial scheduling records（FIN）
information_points.content:
COMM-FIN-4O8：For Bavaria BioPharma Sterile Park, the upfront pilot batch reservation deposit required to hold filling line capacity for an initial technical pilot batch production slot is 22,000 EUR.
COMM-FIN-XL4：For Strathclyde Aseptic Solutions Centre, the upfront pilot batch reservation deposit required to secure filling line capacity for an initial technical pilot batch production slot is 15,000 EUR.
COMM-FIN-O9F：For Wallonia Parenteral Fill Complex, the upfront pilot batch reservation deposit to hold filling line capacity for an initial technical pilot batch production slot is 30,000 EUR.

information_points.title: Customs clearance（TRADE）
information_points.content:
COMM-TRADE-6M7：At Strathclyde Aseptic Solutions Centre, the cross-border export clearance window for exported bulk drug product shipments is 4 days from batch release to export customs clearance.
COMM-TRADE-JVC：At Wallonia Parenteral Fill Complex, the cross-border export clearance window for exported bulk drug product shipments is 6 days from batch release to export customs clearance.
COMM-TRADE-J14：At Bavaria BioPharma Sterile Park, the cross-border export clearance window for exported bulk drug product shipments requires 2 days from batch release to export customs clearance.
